claims.text: The hotel stands at the intersection of Newbury and Arlington Streets in Boston's Back Bay.

findings.quote: luxury hotel at the intersection of Newbury and Arlington Streets, where the bustle of the Back Bay is your playground

claims.text: The Boston Public Garden is directly in front of the hotel.

findings.quote: the idyllic Boston Public Garden your front yard

claims.text: The Boston Public Garden, America's first public botanical garden, is just steps from the hotel.

findings.quote: Discover the lush beauty of Boston Public Garden—America's first public botanical garden—just steps away.

claims.text: Before a two-year renovation and its reopening as The Newbury in May 2021, the property was the Taj Boston.

findings.quote: Prior to a two-year renovation and its reopening as The Newbury in May 2021, the property was the Taj Boston under different ownership.

claims.text: The guestrooms feature custom-designed furnishings by interior designer Alexandra Champalimaud.

findings.quote: Heritage architecture and residential comfort define each guestroom at The Newbury
custom-designed furnishings by acclaimed interior designer **Alexandra Champalimaud**

claims.text: The guestrooms feature original artwork by illustrator Veronica Lawlor.

findings.quote: Heritage architecture and residential comfort define each guestroom at The Newbury
original artwork by illustrator **Veronica Lawlor**

claims.text: Contessa was designed by Ken Fulk and serves Italian cuisine with sweeping city views.

findings.quote: #### **Contessa**
Designed by Ken Fulk, the restaurant features sweeping views of the city, and the dramatic space is complemented by a menu of Italian cuisine.

claims.text: Contessa is the first Boston venture by New York-based Major Food Group.

findings.quote: The 4,000-square-foot restaurant is the first Boston venture by New York–based Major Food Group

claims.text: Afternoon Tea is served in The Street Bar, with fireplaces and views of Newbury Street, and the menu is curated by Major Food Group.

findings.quote: In the wood-paneled glow of The Street Bar - with crackling fireplaces and views of Newbury Street - Afternoon Tea becomes an experience you can’t miss.
Curated by Major Food Group, the menu pairs exceptional teas with savory bites

claims.text: Rooms have Frette linens and robes and Byredo toiletries designed exclusively for the hotel.

findings.quote: plush Frette linens and robes, and toiletries by Byredo, designed exclusively for the hotel

claims.text: The Mansion is a Presidential Suite with a wood-burning fireplace and 15th-floor views of the Boston Public Garden.

findings.quote: Luxurious Presidential Suite featuring a wood-burning fireplace and 15th-floor views of The Boston Public Garden.

claims.text: The building originally opened in 1927 as the first-ever Ritz-Carlton hotel.

findings.quote: originally opened as the first-ever Ritz Carlton Hotel in 1927

claims.text: Contessa is the hotel's glass-enclosed, four-season rooftop restaurant by Major Food Group.

findings.quote: Major Food Group brings its acclaimed creative palette and flair to The Newbury's signature glass-enclosed four-season rooftop restaurant.

claims.text: From October 9 through April 10, a Fireplace Butler prepares and tends the fire in select suites.

findings.quote: From October 9 through April 10, select suites invite you to gather around your very own crackling hearth. Our Fireplace Butler will prepare and tend the fire to perfection.

claims.text: The Library, connected to The Street Bar, offers literary reads curated by the Boston Public Library and is reserved exclusively for hotel guests.

findings.quote: Discreetly connected to the iconic Street Bar, The Library is an intimate salon space of well-crafted provisions and literary reads curated by the Boston Public Library.
The Library is reserved exclusively for guests of The Newbury.

claims.text: Tiffany's Boston flagship is located in the hotel's lobby.

findings.quote: including **Tiffany’s** Boston flagship, located in our lobby

claims.text: The hotel has no spa, though Newbury Street has many salon and massage options.

findings.quote: There’s no spa; Newbury Street boasts a plethora of salon and massage options if you’re seeking one.

claims.text: Arlington Street can be noisy, but suite bedrooms are set away from the street side.

findings.quote: Arlington Street can be noisy, but suite bedrooms are situated away from the street-side
